name: qlrisk_price_treasury_bill
title: Price a TreasuryBill
description:
Price one Treasury Bill (qlrisk TreasuryBill).
Inputs (* required, name=default): maturity*, face_value=100, rate_pct=0, currency=USD. In `advanced` also: effective_date, frequency.
Example: {"maturity": "6M", "face_value": 100} gives NPV 97.88 USD (sample market valued 2026-10-09).
